subject: Re: Kickoff: DReG estimators in the LVM training toolkit
body:
Status.

Estimator module landed March 27 with the bias test Katya suggested: we empirically reproduce that the Roeder-style estimator carries measurable bias at k=64 samples while DReG stays centered, and gradient variance on the inference network drops by an order of magnitude at large k. Telemetry shows it live per-run now, which has already been fun in demos.

Adopter one (the doc-topic VAE) converted cleanly: +0.9 nats test log-likelihood at identical step budget, purely from swapping the estimator. Adopter two (speech LVM) is mid-conversion; their reweighted wake-sleep variant hits the exact case the paper flags, so Efe is being careful with the score-function term.

Risk: the annotation UI slipped a week — rater-queue auth took longer than planned — new ETA April 27. That compresses the human-rating window for adopter two to under three weeks. Doable, but zero slack before the May 18 release cut.

Csilla
